name: Guide arm: 4 then 7 Hz bilateral sine (Gateway Focus 15)
origin: This app's Gateway-style guides (our design; no published protocol)
summary: Experimental arm of the Gateway-style Focus-15 guide (our design, untested): 4 Hz in-phase sine on all temporal coils for 11 min (Focus-10 and Focus-12-style steps), then 7 Hz (count 13 to 15 and open awareness, 12 min), at 2 uT or less. The 7 Hz phase runs 10 min longer than its steps so that a paused guide (the helmet keeps running while the guide is paused) does not cut it short; the guide stops it after its last arm step. A pause still moves the switch to 7 Hz earlier than the steps it belongs to. Run it blinded (real vs sham) from the guide. The Shakti safety page advises against real-time combination with binaural-beat devices.
source: Our design after the Gateway research notes; Wahbeh et al. 2007, J Altern Complement Med 13:199 (7 Hz layer); Shakti safety page https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/safety.htm
